description: Design artifact, NOT a committed runtime contract. Canonical decision ledger closing the four Action Clearance implementation-prerequisites. Extends docs/design/action_clearance/design_decisions.json without reopening any merged decision.

starting_point.later_commit_semantics_change: none (PR #1277 touched only Code Governance change-intelligence docs)

decisions.selected_option: Additive SignalProvenance projection; MVP integrity Level 1 (trusted-ingestion digest); evaluator built to check L1/L2/L3, required level is policy
rejected_options: add provenance fields to the frozen TrustedSignal neutral core
let the evaluator verify signatures against a live key service
decisions.rationale: No producer-key infrastructure exists today and shadow never executes; Level 1 + approved-adapter registry is sufficient and the only level the repo can satisfy now. Raising to L2/L3 for enforcement/high-risk needs no contract change.

decisions.selected_option: Platform integration layer owns the mutable registry; evaluator consumes an immutable versioned source-trust projection read-only
rejected_options: Action Clearance package owns a mutable registry
decisions.rationale: Owning a mutable registry would reintroduce nondeterminism and turn the package into an integration-management system, violating the scope discipline.

decisions.selected_option: Three fingerprint domains: signal_content_fingerprint, signal_provenance_fingerprint, signal_bundle_fingerprint over the merged action_clearance SHA-256 pattern; bundle sorted by signal_id
decisions.rationale: Content and provenance must be independently verifiable and auditable; bundle composes content fingerprints so omission/reorder changes identity.

decisions.selected_option: ClearanceReceiptRepository protocol owned by the Workflow Service; Action Clearance package defines only the receipt schema and reference requirements; no concrete DB dependency
rejected_options: dedicated Action Clearance receipt repository in the package
package depends on a concrete database
decisions.rationale: Matches the merged persistence boundary; keeps the package dependency floor at ugence-governance-contracts; preserves the authority boundary.

decisions.selected_option: Shadow/recommendation guarantees satisfied by the existing append-only in-memory pattern; enforcement guarantees (durable, optimistic concurrency, access control, atomic supersession) require a durable backend
rejected_options: require full production hardening for shadow
decisions.rationale: Stages durability so package core can begin before enforcement-grade persistence exists.

decisions.selected_option: Five-state lifecycle (ISSUED/EXPIRED/SUPERSEDED/REVOKED/INVALIDATED); expiry derived from valid_until; append-only events; immutable body; evaluator never mutates receipts; CONSUMED/EXECUTING/EXECUTED/FAILED excluded
rejected_options: store consumption/execution states on the receipt
persisted-only expiry with a background mutator
decisions.rationale: Separates transient evaluator status from durable lifecycle; keeps consumption in the execution ledger; derived expiry avoids a background mutator.

decisions.selected_option: lineage_key = (tenant_id, authorization_ref, authorized_action_fingerprint, target_ref, profile_id); policy_version NOT in the key but is a supersession trigger; changed action fingerprint => new lineage, never silent replacement
rejected_options: allow action-fingerprint change to supersede silently
decisions.rationale: Lineage identifies what is cleared; policy is an evaluation property. A changed action is a different action requiring new/renewed authorization.

decisions.selected_option: execution_key = (tenant_id, authorization_ref, authorized_action_fingerprint, target_ref, operation); maps onto existing execution_idempotency_key
decisions.rationale: Key must identify the authorized action (stable across a re-issued receipt), not the clearance evaluation; merge_method already folds into the action fingerprint.

decisions.selected_option: reserve_once(...) contract with 8-value result; exactly one ACQUIRED per key; uncertain outcomes require reconciliation before reuse; extend the existing ExecutionRepository port; add a durable atomic backend
rejected_options: put one-time-use in the clearance core
decisions.rationale: The existing repository provides only check-then-insert idempotency, not atomic reserve-once; the atomic property is the P0 enforcement prerequisite. Backend is deferred to keep semantics database-neutral.

decisions.selected_option: Product execution envelope (reusing ExecutionIntent pattern) carries receipt/authorization/action refs; neutral contracts unchanged
rejected_options: add clearance_receipt_ref to the neutral ExecutionDispatchRequest
decisions.rationale: Neutral contracts deliberately exclude product concepts; ExecutionIntent already carries authorization_id/cer_id/idempotency_key/content_hash.

existing_repository_reuse.ExecutionRepository/InMemoryExecutionRep: EXTEND_BEHIND_EXISTING_INTERFACE (add reserve_once + durable backend; check-then-insert only today)

verdict: ACTION CLEARANCE PREREQUISITES PARTIALLY CLOSED — package core may begin, enforcement prerequisites remain
